items.title: CSIRO Uses Serverless Architecture to Query 100x More Genomic Variants on AWS
items.summaryShort: CSIRO Uses Serverless Architecture to Query 100x More Genomic Variants on AWS. CSIRO has developed Serverless Beacon, a serverless architecture for querying genomic variants without copying VCF files into a central database.

items.summaryShort: Article: Multi-Cloud FinOps: An Engineering Framework for Cross-Cloud Cost Optimization. Multi-cloud flexibility comes with hidden egress costs driven by service placement and communication patterns.

items.title: Presentation: Move Fast, Don’t Break Trust: Shipping Constantly with Humans and Beyond
items.summaryShort: Presentation: Move Fast, Don’t Break Trust: Shipping Constantly with Humans and Beyond. Suhail Patel discusses how Monzo structures its software engineering organization and technical stack to ship safely hundreds of times a day.

items.summaryShort: Startups don't need to go viral to win customers. At TechCrunch Disrupt last week, two founders and a VC discussed how to not just gain an early following but keep one.

items.title: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”
